About the cafe

A rooftop table above Jinnah Super

Perched on the rooftop of Union Gold Mall in F-7 Markaz, Karim's Cafe is where Islamabad comes to slow down — good desi food, a proper cup of chai, and open sky in every direction.

From your table you look straight out to the Margalla hills. Come for a long lunch, an evening chai as the light fades, or a late dinner — we're open right through to midnight.

  • Rooftop seating with Margalla views
  • Desi dishes & chai, served all day
  • In the heart of F-7 Markaz (Jinnah Super)
